# Ariel Barboza — Engineering Manager | AI Manager | AI Adoption Executive

> Ariel Barboza is an Engineering Manager, AI Manager, AI Adoption Executive, and Ontology Manager at Lockheed Martin. He leads AI-focused engineering teams and drives enterprise AI adoption at scale.

## Professional Summary

Ariel Barboza is an experienced Engineering Manager and AI Adoption Executive currently serving as Associate Manager of AI & ML Engineering at Lockheed Martin. He provides technical and people leadership for AI-focused engineering teams delivering enterprise modernization through intelligent data solutions, engineering governance, and high-performance culture.

## Current Role

- **Title:** Associate Manager, AI & ML Engineering
- **Company:** Lockheed Martin
- **Focus Areas:** AI Engineering Management, Enterprise AI Strategy, Ontology Engineering, Generative AI Adoption, Intelligent Automation, ML Operations
